overview: The Application Desk is the controlled bridge between Admissions and the operational SuperCampus system. It takes a confirmed admitted applicant and orchestrates identity resolution, document verification, academic and finance mapping, approval, student-number generation, Student Master creation, user-account provisioning and access assignment — driven by tenant configuration rather than hard-coded rules.

workflows.name: Standard Onboarding
workflows.summary: Confirmed admission through to an activated SuperCampus student

steps.title: Admission Trigger
steps.description: Listen for a confirmed admission and evaluate intake rules

steps.title: Onboarding Case Creation
steps.description: Create the onboarding case after duplicate protection passes

steps.title: Applicant Data Review
steps.description: Operator reviews imported admission data under field-level rules

steps.title: Identity Verification
steps.description: Match against existing people and classify duplicates

steps.title: Document Verification
steps.description: Verify every mandatory document on the configured checklist

steps.title: Academic Mapping
steps.description: Map the applicant onto campus, department, program, year and batch

steps.title: Section Allocation
steps.description: Allocate a section subject to capacity and allocation rules

steps.title: Finance Mapping
steps.description: Link the applicable fee structure and confirm finance state

steps.title: Approval
steps.description: Run the configured approval chain

steps.title: Student Number Generation
steps.description: Transactionally allocate the institutional student number

steps.title: Student Master Creation
steps.description: Create the Student Master record owned by Core Administration

steps.title: User Account Creation
steps.description: Provision the platform account and link it to the student profile

steps.title: Module Access Provisioning
steps.description: Assign the student role and tenant-enabled module access

steps.title: Welcome Communication
steps.description: Send activation details to student and guardian

steps.title: Onboarding Completed
steps.description: Close the case and emit OnboardingCompleted

workflows.name: Hold & Resume
workflows.summary: Pause a case against a blocking reason and resume from the last valid stage

steps.title: Raise Hold
steps.description: Record reason, owner and resume condition

steps.title: Notify Responsible Team
steps.description: Alert the team that owns the blocking action

steps.title: Resolve Blocking Condition
steps.description: Missing document uploaded, finance cleared or mapping corrected

steps.title: Resume Workflow
steps.description: Return the case to its recorded resume stage, not to the beginning

workflows.name: Exception Handling
workflows.summary: Duplicate, mapping, finance and provisioning failures without breaking the workflow

steps.title: Detect Exception
steps.description: Guard failure or integration error raises a typed exception

steps.title: Route to Exception Queue
steps.description: Assign to the team that owns the failing area

steps.title: Manual Resolution
steps.description: Operator resolves the duplicate, mapping or finance block

steps.title: Retry Provisioning
steps.description: Replay the failed effect using its idempotency key
